thesis: CRAI has a clean uptrend backed by accelerating, profitable growth: Q3 revenue rose 15.6% YoY, net income rose 21%, the dividend was raised 17.5%, and the stock is holding a post-earnings gap near its 52-week high while the market sells off. The business is cash generative with low dilution risk and no binary event is expected soon. The setup is only moderate, though. RSI is 74, reward/risk is about 1.3, and the regime is risk-off, so the bull case is for a small position on a pullback into the 208-213 zone, not a chase. A volume-confirmed break above 217.7 is the alternative trigger.
